notes.title: Patch 0.6.22.1088
notes.content:
==Patch Notes==
UI
You can find detailed information in the Encyclopedia. It is placed in the left page of the encyclopedia tab of the ledger.

You can view event logs of previous turns even after a game load in the right page of the encyclopedia tab of the ledger.

Loading screen will now contain tips as well as quotes.
Gameplay
Massacre and Plunder events no longer requires culturally difference. You can use your general for activating these actions on enemy towns even if they are culturally similar to your general.

The population growth will be limited to just above 10. A soft max is used to limit the growth. Most efficient growth will be around a population of 6.

Now explorers can choose to gain Roadworks ability. This ability cannot be gained at the same time with Astronomer.

Impact of monopoly is lowered to avoid dramatic increase in grudge from several opponents spontenaously.
Fixes
Several bug fixes are applied to remedy frequent reported exceptions.

notes.title: Natives are here!
notes.content:
Patch 0.5.20.1007


Playtest distribution policy has changed:

I believe IA has reached a huge playtester count and don't think we need playtesters until release! But so that you can still send invites to your friends and families so they can join the imperialism.



Natives:

Now your explorers has to watch their steps! You will discover the Americas is now filled with native villages. The outcome of any interactions is quite simple: either natives organise and attack, or get enslaved. This can be used to your benefit, such that you can find much needed labor for your colonies from the native populace.



Spontaneous Actions:

You units when over a town, can react unpredictably if they have these traits; Zealot, Greedy, Hysteric, Bloodlust. Especially culturally different towns are subject to plundering and massacring. Yet your enemies will blame you for thier behaviour.



Resource distribution changes:

Now new world contains more gold. All Spice resource is removed from the Old World. I can possibly change its name to pepper.



Influence mechanics:

Now every town has faction influence metrics, determined by the towns nearby, trade routes, etc. Now, Independent cities (FreeStates) will choose to switch ownership if there is enough influence in the town. The min required influence is determined by the population size.



UI changes:

Now the action buttons show how many resources, action points or gold each action requires. Fail reasons will now be available only if hovered.



New tutorial: 

Replantation tutorial is now available.

Discipline is now removed from unit attributes. In the future, discipline bonuses will be added as form of traits.

notes.title: Patch 0.4.16.946
notes.content:

Gameplay:

 Units can be garrisoned in towns. They can be reorganised and assembled again in towns.
 Shadow Master can start smuggling routes. They are identical to trade routes but requires criminals, cost more, and cannot be blocked by boycotts.
 Trade routes can be pillaged by regiments containing shadow master and units
 Score calculations


Visual:

 VFX: Smoky chimney
 VFX: Birds flying when units enter forest tiles
 VFX: civilians running away upon enslavement or massacring
 VFX: fire upon enslavement, massacring or pillaging
 Town buildings are set by the citizens and garrison


Bug fixes:

 Fixed: Some settings were not persistent between scenes and sessions.
 Fixed: The UI setting would not set in the main menu.

notes.title: Feature Packed Patch is Here!
notes.content:
=New Mechanics=
Freelancer demand: Any labor that is not assigned will be demand for raw resources. In return they will pay the market price. This replaces tax system.

Experience system: Now upgrades require experience, which is gained through action abilities. Player can have more than one upgrade, however the required experience raises logarithmically.

=Gameplay Changes=
Merchant Upgrade: Entrepreneur can hire convicts or destitute citizens to settle in the new world. Must settle next to valuable resources. Will reset the class progress.

Seasick, Frostbite and SunBurnt traits: These traits are dependent on how many turns that a unit spend in the sea/snow/desert. While SeaSick decreases discipline and movement points, Frostbite and SunBurnt decreases hitpoints and movementpoints.

Now citizens born to other citizens born tier lower then their parents, unless they are lowest tier classes, peasants or slaves. ie. children of a master is automatically artisan.

Units can only be disbanded in the capital. Disbanding no longer removes the occupation. They can be reassembled in the assemble window. This is so the parties can be reorganized.

=Visuals=
With the new ocean shader, seas will look even more realistic!

=Music=
Serviam by Emil Posner is added to the campaign

=Fixes=
Save n load system issues. 

Save file version check is added.

notes.title: New patch includes: New labor system, Save N Load system, new UI artwork
notes.content:
Patch Notes since 0.1.8.575:

== UI ==
New UI art includes more use of ribbons. It also keeps the borders less distruptive.


== Gameplay ==
Load'N Save system enables saving your progress and continue later. Works in Playtest scene.

New labor system makes an equal distribution of laborers more rewarding. Labor is now calculated based on two parameters, base labor and labor boost. Lower tier citizens, slaves, peasants and apprentices, has only base labor, while higher tier citizens has both, base labor and a labor boost. Labor boost is multiplied with the total base labor in the town and added to the final labor.

Salt resource is now among the already discovered resources.

Changes in the UI and labor system requires reworking the tutorials. So Tutorials are disabled for the being.


== Fixes ==
Target FPS is set to 60. This is done to avoid GPU overdrive in the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8.559 introduces refugees!
notes.content:
=Patch Notes=

Mechanics
Town occupation mechanics get additional behaviour. When a town being invaded, if the citizens are prefer resisting, yet the enemy is overwhelming, then the citizens will choose to form a refugee and flee instead of defending. This will cause instability in the areas neighboring warzones. Refugees move as soon as they are created.

Culture traits are now added to the game. Currently cultures do not have any significant impact, but it will improve the communication between citizens and agents in future updates.

Balancing
Building quarries now cost 70 AP instead of 80.

Rennes is renamed as Nantes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7.535
notes.content:
Gameplay:
New coastal towns come with a dock.

New towns get names depending on their location. Towns on the east of the map gets old world names, ones on the west will get colonial town names. They can now be renamed.

Settings:
UI Scale Slider is replaced with a Text Box. This makes avoids unintentional sliding and scaling to too far.

InGame Menu settings are now saved between game sessions.

Fixes:
Direction of moving units are aligned correctly.

Missing improvement sprites are fixed

notes.title: Finally, players can found new towns!
notes.content:
==Patch Notes==

Choose unit upgrades
Newly recruited explorers can now choose a skill; Geologist or Urban Planner.

Found new towns
Explorers with Urban Planner skill can hire settlers from player's towns and found new towns. These towns need to be located at least 2 tiles away from any owned land.

Criminals can be convicted
Smugglers can now be detained and convicted by units. 15% chance that units convict smugglers or bandits in the town. This results in removal of any existing smuggling route.

Performance updates
Some performance issues due to survey overlay when an explorer or builder is selected is fixed with expected performance increase up to 20 FPS.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7.522
notes.content:
---Patch notes---


New Music:
Renaissance Soundtrack is added to campaign!!!

Immigration process due to discrimination:
Unwanted citizens who are not rich or destitute seek will safe heaven in nearby towns.

Unrest and disease now impact labor and tax:
Labor and tax output is now decreased by low health or unrest. Rioting and plagued will deliver no labor or tax, while, striking and sickly provides -2 less labor or -10 tax income.

Disband ability:
Too many units to feed? Players can now retire their units in their towns. 

Map updates:
More resources are added to the map, including Grapes! 

Balancing:
Town population vs town region size is rebalanced. Now empty towns has no extra tiles in their control.

UI update:
Players can view all regiments under the date on the left of the screen.

notes.title: Another Spanish Flag hang is fixed with Patch 505
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback. Based on recent errors I managed to reproduce and fix another Spanish flag hang issue. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Complete Patch Notes

Wealth traits, poor, rich, v.rich and destitute are introduced.

Unit movement speed are doubled.

Massacre and vandalize passive abilities are added.

Engineers now can build level 2 buildings.

Increased warehouse limit to 100.

Added taxes and wage pays

notes.title: Reproduction traits, Grape resource and more!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Gameplay
1. Reproduction traits: Expected Parent, Recent Parent, Parent traits are added to build up the way to creation of new units. This process currently fast (ie.3 months pregnancy) for testing.

2. New resource type, Grapes, are added.

3. New beverage productions are added. Now beverages can also be produced from 2 wheat or 1 grape as well.

4. Peasant luxury requirement is changed from condiment to beverage. Apprentice luxury requirement from beverage to condiment. Now, production of beverage should be easier with 5 possible methods.

Controls
5. The mouse button used to drag the map is now changeable at the settings.

Visuals
6. Town UI is extended to show citizen requirements, ie luxury item and meal.

7. Additonal movement indicators are added to appear inbetween tiles.

8. Resources in negative trend are now indicated with orange. Resources that will be insufficient are indicated with red.

notes.title: Small patch to fix hanging during End Turn
notes.content: Thank you all who reported this issue. Apparently the game would hang during End Turn event, due to improper initiation of some dictionaries. This is now fixed and uploaded to Steam as Version 0.1.6.437.

notes.title: Religion, Discrimination and Unrest Traits are here!
notes.content:
Patch Notes


1.1. Discrimination traits: Estranged, Discriminated and Unwanted
discrimination occurs when citizens are excluded from the community by being in a different religion, or different wealth

1.2. Religion traits: Catholic, Protestant, Orthodox, Coptic, Sunni, Shia, Jewish, Animist and Fetishist
religion can spread inside towns or between towns and armies. Religion type, positive traits, melancholy and other factors impact. Besides religions, we also have Newly Convert and True Believer traits. Citizens with these traits do not tend to be converted easily.

1.3. Unrest traits: Protesting, On Strike and Rioting
These traits occur in the same order, leading to actions such as vandalism, massacre and rebellion [actions are not yet implemented]. Moving units in town helps to calm down the unrest. Also depression can lead to Hysterical trait, which increases reactivity of the citizens. So keep extra eye on hysterical citizens.

2. Warning signs when a given production order will not be met in current resource or labor supply. This is most likely to happen if an order left from previous turn cannot be met anymore.

3. Added cliffy shores back

4. Several small fixes

notes.title: Update for Patch 0.1.6.425
notes.content:
Patch notes


New tile shapes:
Replaced flat-top hex tiles with pointy-top hex tiles. I think this makes the game spread more east-west orientation, in the same direction of European exploration.

Labor output balancing:
Now slaves and peasants produce 2, apprentices produce 3, artisans produce 4 and masters produce 5 labor. This change makes easier to support larger armies while decreasing the impact of masters.

New Depth of Field effect:
The new Depth of Field blur method creates much smoother blur effect.

notes.title: PATCH 0.1.4.397
notes.content:
---Patch notes--- 

-Chinese translation and Language selection option
Now you can set the game language to Chinese as well as English.


-UI scaling option
Now you can set the scale of the UI in the game menu


-New Trade mechanics
Now, to start a new trade route, the buyer has to have a trade consulate in the seller's capital or an agent with Merchant Trait in the vicinity of the town of origin.


-New resource layout
New resource layout allows the players to see locations of known resources in the map. You can also see where a resource is previously NOT found. You can set the active layout from the dropdown at top right corner.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4.381
notes.content:
New features;
To begin trade, now you need to have
1.there must be an active offer from a seller
2.there must be a clear path between the seller and the buyer capitals
3.buyer must have enough transporters to perform the trade
4.buyer must have a negotiator (either a merchant or a trade consulate near the seller's capital)
5.the seller must not be boycotting the buyer.

Engineer can build mine or quarries as well.

A new original Soundtrack; Open Seas

notes.title: patch 1.3.295
notes.content:
Transport Capacity introduced!
Any extraction site, such as a farm, belongs to a town. This farm will harvest wheat, but now it depends on your transport capacity what portion of it may be transported to the capital. 

Transport capacity is determined by several things, and can be also improved on multiple ways like improving the roads or assigning more vessels and wagons to it through the Towns window. Of course, you must first build those wagons and vessels first.

Other notable Changes

 boats and units on the boats now sway with waves.
 Transport capacity mechanics.
 added Towns window where towns of the empire can be visited, and transport capacity may be set.
